note: Dated reports that Chennai's police closed these subways for water, collected on 11 October 2026 from news pages open to anyone, in this project's own words. Every report names the place. 'from' and 'to' are days in Indian time. This is what one round of searching found, not a record of every flood.

events.name: Rain of 26 November 2021
events.says: Rain from Friday night; 82.5 mm by 05:30 on Saturday. Police closed the Rangarajapuram and Ganeshapuram subways and restricted traffic at Madley subway.

events.name: Rain of 30 December 2021
events.says: Rain from the morning into the evening. The Gengu Reddy, Madley, Aranganathan and RBI subways were closed.

events.name: Rain of 29 November 2023
events.says: Rain on Wednesday night, 62 mm at Kolathur. The Perambur subway was waterlogged.

events.name: Cyclone Michaung
events.says: A list of closed subways published at 04:10 on 4 December names all nine.
